items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker ducked in, Dizzy Gillespie, Ben Webster, countless musicians of the era

ctx.x: I paid -- I went shopping on Sunday morning, and I got at the club at 10 AM, I had gone down to the Italian section, which was open on Sundays, and this is the first Sunday I cooked, and I made 10 to 15 gallons of Slum Gullion* Now this was something I developed over the years, which is elbow macaroni with bits of ground beef and steak and Italian sausages and peppers, cheese and what have you, and with a light tomato and garlic sauce (Gee, and I'm getting hungry now!) mixed in all together, and I put it in the…

All day long the kitchen got busy, and as word passed around the street, Charlie Parker ducked in, Dizzy Gillespie, Ben Webster, countless musicians of the era that were developing their styles, especially Dizzy with his "salted peanuts," he was still working on them.
